If you move out of the practice area you may need to register with another practice. All new patients are invited to make an appointment to have a health check with our practice nurse. About New Patient Health Checks: Register With Us To register with us, please check you live within our catchment area; you can do this using the map below. Once you have ensured you live within our practice boundary, please email a request stating your address to nelondonicb.theazadpractice@nhs.net. If you can provide photo ID and proof of address to speed up the process and correctly match your details please email these with any account details crossed out. We will then send you an auto registration link which automatically registers you within 2 days. If there is a problem we will try to process your details manually or contact you. Registration forms are also available from Reception at the Practice, or can be downloaded here and emailed or delivered to the practice once completed. You can also register to the practice online via the link below. Register for this GP Online We will not refuse registration on the grounds of: Practice Area If you would like to check whether you are resident within our Practice area and so eligible to register with us a Practice then please enter your postcode below.
